a.lede: The Justice and Commerce Departments have announced an investigation into Megaspeed over concerns that it may have been involved in the illegal export of Nvidia's AI hardware. The company was previously run by the woman officials have accused of being a Chinese spy while having an affair with Jensen Huang while he was Nvidia CEO.
a.title: US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal

b.lede: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
